description: This file contains functions and methods for managing VLAN and bridge configurations via netlink in Linux, including showing VLAN tunnels, listing VLANs, and adding/removing VLAN and tunnel info.

classes.name: Handle
classes.description: A struct representing a handle for netlink operations, with methods for VLAN and bridge management.

methods.name: BridgeVlanTunnelShow
methods.description: Retrieves VLAN ID to tunnel ID mappings.

methods.name: BridgeVlanList
methods.description: Lists VLANs associated with network devices.

methods.name: BridgeVlanAddTunnelInfo
methods.description: Adds VLAN tunnel information to a network device.

methods.name: BridgeVlanAddRangeTunnelInfoRange
methods.description: Adds a range of VLAN tunnel information entries.

methods.name: BridgeVlanDelTunnelInfo
methods.description: Deletes VLAN tunnel information from a network device.

methods.name: BridgeVlanDelRangeTunnelInfoRange
methods.description: Deletes a range of VLAN tunnel information entries.

methods.name: BridgeVlanAdd
methods.description: Adds a VLAN to a network device.

methods.name: BridgeVlanAddRange
methods.description: Adds a range of VLANs to a network device.

methods.name: BridgeVlanDel
methods.description: Removes a VLAN from a network device.

methods.name: BridgeVlanDelRange
methods.description: Removes a range of VLANs from a network device.
